text: APM agents for Go, Java, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Python, and Ruby monitor application performance across the stack
quote: Monitor application performance across your stack. We've got agents for Go, Java, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Python, and Ruby.

text: NerdGraph, a GraphQL API, can query New Relic data and configure some platform features
quote: NerdGraph is our GraphQL-format API that lets you query New Relic data and configure some New Relic features.

text: NerdGraph API explorer lets you try out API calls interactively
quote: An easy way to experiment with the NerdGraph API is to use the NerdGraph API explorer.

text: NRQL is a SQL-like query language for querying New Relic data
quote: New Relic Query Language (NRQL) is a SQL-like language for querying your New Relic data.

text: The query language behind built-in charts and dashboards is available to users for building their own views and alerts
quote: The same query language that powers New Relic's built-in charts and dashboards is available to you, so you can build the views and alerts your team needs.

text: NRQL-based alerts are the primary and most powerful alert type
quote: Set up NRQL-based alerts (our primary and most powerful type of alert)

text: Users define the data to watch, the alert thresholds, and who is notified and how
quote: You define the data to watch, the thresholds that if exceeded mean an issue, who is notified, and how.

text: Any signal can be evaluated against a threshold or for abnormal behavior
quote: Configure any signal to be evaluated against a threshold, or if it exhibits abnormal behavior.

text: Notifications route issues to the correct system or team
quote: Route issues to the correct system or team using notifications.

text: Services can be instrumented with OpenTelemetry for platform-agnostic observability
quote: Instrument your service with OpenTelemetry and gain platform-agnostic observability.

text: Define and consume SLIs and SLOs for applications
quote: With New Relic, you can define and consume service level indicators (SLIs) and service level objectives (SLOs) for your applications.

text: Service levels can be created in modes ranging from one-click to fully customizable advanced setups
quote: facilitates creation of service levels with different modes of complexity, from one-click to advanced modes fully customizable for advanced users.

text: Build and share tailored charts and dashboards from data anywhere in the platform
quote: Through our UI you can build and share tailored user-friendly charts and visualizations. Go to our dashboard capability to gather and chart the specific data you want to see, the way you want to see it, from anywhere in our platform.

text: Dashboards can be shared with outside stakeholders through public live URLs
quote: Share dashboards with stakeholders outside your New Relic organization via publicly accessible live dashboard URLs.

text: Custom, high-density interactive visualizations with a consistent UI
quote: Drive insight with custom, high-density interactive visualizations with a consistent UI.

text: Ask questions, troubleshoot, and explore telemetry using plain language
quote: It allows you to ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language.

text: Built-in AI assistant helps when a query isn't working
quote: If you're struggling to get a query to work, ask our AI assistant to help you.

text: An MCP server provides a standardized way to connect AI development tools to New Relic platform context
quote: a standardized, scalable way to connect your favorite AI development tools directly to the rich context of the New Relic platform

text: The MCP server converts plain-English questions into NRQL and returns results
quote: Ask questions in plain English, and the MCP server converts them to NRQL to get results—even if you're not a NRQL expert.

text: Logs UI shows all logs and filters them by text or attributes
quote: From the main logs UI page, you can see all your logs and then filter down to logs with specific text, or other attributes.

text: APM agents add metadata to logs for logs-in-context and forward them to New Relic without third-party tools
quote: By default, our APM agents do two things: add metadata to your logs, which gives you logs in context (ability to see logs data in various relevant places in our platform) and forward your logs to New Relic.

text: Log management connects logs with other telemetry and infrastructure data in one place
quote: New Relic offers a fast, scalable log management platform so you can connect your logs with the rest of your telemetry and infrastructure data in a single place.

text: Perpetual free tier that includes 100 GB/month of data ingest
quote: Sign up for free access with our perpetual free tier and 100 GB/month of data ingest included.

text: Search for entities across all New Relic accounts
quote: Entity Search: Search for entities across all your New Relic accounts

text: Record APM application deployment markers
quote: Deployment Markers: Easily record an APM Application deployment within New Relic.

text: Real-time visibility into multi-cloud and Kubernetes spend
quote: Gain real-time visibility into multi-cloud and Kubernetes spend.

text: AI finds user friction points in session recordings so users don't have to watch the videos
quote: Skip searching the video. Have AI identify friction points for you.

text: Automatically controls behavior and token usage across an AI stack
quote: Control behavior and token usage across your AI stack—automatically.

text: Monitor AWS Lambda functions using CloudWatch data and code-level instrumentation
quote: Monitor your serverless AWS Lambda functions using both CloudWatch data and code-level instrumentation.

text: Custom events can be attached to Lambda invocations
quote: Optionally, add [custom events](https://docs.newrelic.com/docs/using-new-relic/welcome-new-relic/getting-started/glossary#custom-event) that will be associated with your Lambda invocation

text: Synthetic monitoring simulates user activity and API calls from global locations
quote: Simulate end-user activity and API calls from locations around the world, so you can find problems before your users do.

text: Browser monitoring can be deployed for apps
quote: Monitor all your apps and services ... Deploy browser monitoring ... Get started with synthetic monitoring

text: Visibility into hosts, containers, providers, network, and infrastructure
quote: Get visibility into hosts, containers, providers, network, and infrastructure.

text: New Relic CLI manages entity tags, defines workloads, and records deployment markers
quote: You can use the New Relic CLI to manage entity tags, define workloads, record deployment markers, and much more.

text: CLI can be used in CI/CD pipelines and local troubleshooting workflows
quote: The New Relic CLI enables the integration of New Relic into your existing workflows. Be it fetching data from your laptop while troubleshooting an issue, or adding New Relic into your CI/CD pipeline.

text: CLI output can be formatted as JSON, Text, or YAML
quote: --format string    output text format [JSON, Text, YAML] (default "JSON")

text: CLI profiles store credentials and settings that apply to any command
quote: Profiles contain credentials and settings that you can apply to any CLI command

text: nr1 CLI fetches data using NRQL
quote: nr1 nrql | Fetches data using NRQL.

text: nr1 CLI scaffolds Nerdpacks, Nerdlets, launchers, or catalogs from templates
quote: Creates a new component from a template: Nerdpack, Nerdlet, launcher, or catalog.

text: Nerdpacks can be served locally for testing and development
quote: nr1 nerdpack:serve | Serves your Nerdpack for testing and development purposes

text: Accounts can be subscribed to a specific Nerdpack and channel
quote: Subscribes your account to a specific Nerdpack and channel.

text: Catalog info for a Nerdpack can be gathered and submitted from the CLI
quote: nr1 catalog:submit | Gathers and submits the catalog info on the current folder.

text: SDK supports building Nerdlets and visualizations and fetching New Relic or third-party data
quote: The SDK provides everything you need to build your Nerdlets, create visualizations, and fetch New Relic or third-party data.

text: SDK layout components support complex layouts without writing CSS
quote: These components give you control over the layout, and help you build complex layout designs without having to deal with the CSS.

text: The agent can run as an SDK for the chosen runtime to enable SDK-based instrumentation
quote: SDK based instrumentation requires you to enable New Relic agent as an SDK for your chosen runtime.

text: Security RX Agent assesses vulnerabilities in the context of your tech stack and suggests a remediation plan
quote: The Security RX Agent assesses a vulnerability in the context of your tech stack and turns it into a suggested remediation plan.

text: Agent can open Jira tickets or GitHub issues that trigger external coding agents to start a fix
quote: can open a Jira ticket or GitHub issue in the affected repository — triggering a coding agent you already use (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or a custom agent) to initiate a fix

text: Automated remediation, going beyond assistance
quote: Move beyond assistance to automated remediation.

text: AI-powered summaries of workload health, performance trends, and potential issues
quote: AI insights provide AI-powered summaries of your workload's health, performance trends, and potential issues.

text: Agent Control with Terraform manages fleets of agents declaratively at scale
quote: New Relic Agent Control with Terraform provides a powerful, declarative solution for managing fleets of agents at scale.

text: Diagnostics CLI automatically detects common New Relic problems and suggests troubleshooting steps
quote: The Diagnostics CLI (nrdiag) is a utility that automatically detects common problems with New Relic products. If the Diagnostics CLI detects a problem, it suggests troubleshooting steps.

text: Diagnostics CLI checks agent configurations and creates zipped logs ready to attach to support tickets
quote: The program checks your New Relic agent configurations for issues and generates zipped troubleshooting logs that are ready to be attached to support tickets.

text: Diagnostics data stays local by default and can optionally be uploaded over HTTPS to view in the UI
quote: By default, this data is not transmitted to New Relic. You do have the option to upload this information to your New Relic account over HTTPS.
